name: manual_c7b9ff
claim: Check both directions of a peer link after any restart and when either side reports a failure. A connect timeout before TLS on a host whose firewall rules exist usually means no listener: confirm Get-NetTCPConnection on the port and the owning process first, then profile, firewall and ARP.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: Windows-to-Mac delivery kept working while Mac-to-Windows timed out before TLS; the Windows 8443 listener was simply gone. It took a peer report to notice.
